rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Re-checked all 8 chunks against the post-lean-pass body (source_sha 90e6701c…). The lean-pass cuts (maintainer L77) removed sentences, not headers or the referents those sentences pointed at, so no dangling antecedents were created: chunk 1 L23's cut clause ('The reasons for personal-first land in Phase 3…') was itself a forward pointer that already named its destination heading, so removing it removes a pointer, not a referent; chunk 4 L51-52's merge (5→2 sentences) left 'the sharpen' in L52 resolving to the sharpening action just described in the same bullet/chunk; chunk 5 L58's cut ('That's the ship.') and chunk 6 L63's cut (coffee/channel color + 'sharpen it sharper') removed trailing color, not antecedents anything downstream needed. Closest candidate: chunk 7 L71 'Module 4 reads this skill... it walks a real task against everything you've built' — 'it' = Module 4 (same clause), 'this skill' = the test-strategy skill named in the H1 and reused throughout (arc-earned, chunk 0). Chunk 7 L73 'came over at the fork' and 'here' resolve via the session-artifacts carve-out (same sentence names 'the side-quest worktree'). No never-named, vague, or re-chunk-stranded referent found.

No 'the opening lecture said…' style callback into another file's content anywhere in the body. Closest candidate unchanged by the lean pass: chunk 7 L71 'Module 4 reads this skill' names the destination module by number as a forward-pointing closer (permitted per §2's own text on closers), not a positional reference into module 4's content.

rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw' callback to a sibling module's exercise/lecture beat anywhere in body. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File contains no guess-before-reveal / predict-then-watch instruction anywhere in the body; the exercise's shape is author-then-invoke-then-critique, unaffected by the lean pass's line-level trims.

Closest candidate: chunk 5 (Phase 3, lines 54-59) now carries only ONE body bullet after the lean pass cut its trailing 'That's the ship.' sentence — but the surviving bullet (L58: 'The skill is already shipped… There is no separate install step.') is a standalone claim (nothing left to do, install already happened), not a wait-state or context-dependent fragment. Every one of the 7 body chunks still carries a standalone instructive or evaluative claim.

Re-checked all 7 non-title headers against their post-trim chunk content; none of the lean-pass cuts removed the sentence that makes a header true. Closest edge case unchanged: chunk 5 header 'Phase 3: Ship the skill personal-first' (L54) vs. content 'The skill is already shipped… no separate install step' (L58) — header names the act, content confirms it, not contradicted.

`grep -inE 'Not [A-Z][a-z]+\.' curriculum/exercises/author-test-strategy-skill.md` this session, restricted to body lines 1-74 → 0 hits (the only hit, L77, is inside the maintainer block, out of body scope). `grep -inE 'most (useful|important|valuable)|one of the (best|most)|best (way|move|skill)|greatest|longest beat' curriculum/exercises/author-test-strategy-skill.md` this session → 0 hits, no self-grading superlative. No anaphora/epistrophe triple in the current body (chunk 0 L13's 'one author pass, one self-critique, one invocation, ship' remains, each leg a distinct concrete step, matching the file's own backing-block claim `hardened-by-critique-and-invocation`). No number-with-retraction pattern. No verb-triplet with an empty leg. Chunk 4 L49 'same-window self-charity' is a coined handle explained in the same sentence, not an abstraction-noun stack. 'Codebase truth' (chunk1 L23, chunk2 L32, chunk6 L62/65) recurs but is grounded each time by an adjacent concrete example or list (Postgres-in-Docker at L32; framework/mocking-policy/integration-boundary/flakiness-patterns at L62) rather than standing in for nothing concrete.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This rule's own text cites a '2026-08-25 sweep' with a ~100% maintainer cut rate, and this file's own maintainer block (L77) is dated 2026-08-25 and lists the exact cuts of this shape: doctrine restatement ('The skill proves itself only when it runs on real code.' — restated the theatre line, cut), self-referential design commentary ('The authoring muscle is what Module 3 installs.' — cut, tagged '§16b' by the maintainer note itself), and aphorism kickers ('That's the ship.'; 'Not every skill graduates to a shared kit.') — all removed. Re-reading what SURVIVED for the same three classes: closest candidates are chunk 4 L52 second sentence ('A skill that names its own gap is more useful to a teammate than one that pretends it's finished.') and chunk 6 L65 ('Personal stays a fine final home. The test: would teammates use it as-written, and does the skill carry enough codebase truth to survive their review.') — both earn their slot under the rule's own bar ('what does it add — a move, an object, a tell, a priority'): the first is a TELL for choosing honest-TODO over false-completeness (not a re-announcement of a law already stated), the second supplies an actual decision TEST ('The test: …') for the graduate-or-not branch the chunk exists to resolve, not decoration restating 'ships personal first'. No surviving bullet matches class (a)/(b)/(c) as the compendium defines them.
